title: RefinedKeyframeLine
description: One line of the optional refined_keyframes.jsonl in a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md): a keyframe's transform re-read at session end from the ARAnchor the Swift capture module added at that keyframe. Where a line exists, it is a better estimate of the keyframe pose than the one in poses.jsonl. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: frame only increases and is a keyframe in poses.jsonl.

transform.description: The refined camera pose, with the same convention as poses.jsonl.
